draft.title: Becoming a parent
card: Becoming a parent is a major life change. It can affect a person's responsibilities, relationships and finances.
Responsibilities
parents become responsible for the care, safety and daily needs of a child, such as feeding and health.
Relationships
time and attention shift to the child. The couple's relationship and contact with friends may change.
Finances
costs can rise for items such as food and childcare. Income may fall if a parent works fewer hours. These changes can add stress.
draft.remember: Parenthood brings change that can add stress.

a.q: Which is a change in a parent's responsibilities after a baby is born?
opts: Meeting the baby's daily care and safety needs
Paying for items such as nappies and childcare
Having less time to spend with friends
Feeling stress because of the new demands
a.why: Responsibilities are about caring for the child's needs, such as feeding and safety. Paying for items is a finance change. Less time with friends is a relationship change.
a.clue: Think about who now looks after the child's needs.

b.q: After Jess has a baby, she works fewer hours and her income drops, while baby costs rise. Which change is this?
opts: A change in finances
A change in relationships
A change in responsibilities
A change in stress levels
b.why: Lower income and higher costs are changes in money, so they are finances. Responsibilities is tempting, but the card places care of the child there, not the money. Jess's changes are about income and costs.
b.clue: Focus on income and costs, not on who cares for the baby.

a.best: Meeting the baby's daily care and safety needs

problems.detail: The clue ('Focus on income and costs, not on who cares for the baby') points straight at finances and rules out the main distractor, so students can answer without understanding the idea.

check.summary: The facts and answers are sound. The clue for question b nearly gives the answer away by steering students to income and costs and away from responsibilities.
